_comment: Brand-specific copy for the guidelines page. guidelines/build.py reads this file with brands.json, tokens.json, snippets/type-tokens.json, snippets/palette.css and snippets/data-color.css, and writes index.html. No color value, token name, role or URL belongs here unless it sits inside a sentence: the build checks every hex and every token name in this file against the kit. Edit, then run python3 guidelines/build.py.
say: Royal Ambulance is a Bay Area medical transportation company under Collective Edge.

bigPlate.caption: The primary lockup on white. Crown and wordmark travel together.

logoLead: Every lockup, on its correct ground. The file named for a ground goes on that ground.

horizontal-on-light.name: Horizontal
horizontal-on-light.use: Primary lockup. Default anywhere with horizontal room.

horizontal-on-dark.name: Horizontal
horizontal-on-dark.use: Primary lockup on dark purple grounds.

mark-on-light.name: Crown
mark-on-light.use: Icon only. Favicons, badges, avatars, table corners.

mark-on-dark.name: Crown
mark-on-dark.use: Icon only on dark purple grounds.

stacked-on-dark.name: Stacked
stacked-on-dark.use: Vertical lockup for portrait and square formats on dark.

stacked-on-light.name: Stacked
stacked-on-light.use: Vertical lockup for portrait and square formats on light.

clearSpace.unit: the height of the crown mark

logoNotes: The fill on light is #43205B in every lockup. The fill on dark is #FFFFFF.
On a header band the logo is 1.6in wide.
If the clear space is short, shrink the logo.
Under 1.5in wide, use the horizontal lockup in place of the stacked one.

palette.name: Dark Purple
palette.use: The dominant color. Header bands, title slides, table header rows. The band carries no rule.

palette.name: Purple
palette.use: The working accent. Bars, buttons, links and brand-colored text on white.

palette.name: Light Purple
palette.never: Never body text. Never a large background. Never on #2F193B.

palette.name: Surface 2
palette.use: The second tint, a step under Surface. Step 100 of the purple ramp.

palette.name: White
palette.use: The page background. Text on any dark purple.
palette.never: Never white text on Light Purple.

colorLead: Purple is the whole palette. Text and rules come from the shared neutrals.
colorNote: Three purples do the work. Dark Purple opens every document, Purple marks, Royal Purple is the logo.

partner.title: With Collective Edge
partner.lead: Royal is an operating company under Collective Edge and the reader should be able to see it.
partner.note: The Powered by Collective Edge lockup rides beside the Royal mark, never inside it, under a hairline. It appears once per surface.

plates.label: On white
plates.text: The black Collective Edge file, under a hairline.

plates.label: On the band
plates.text: The white Collective Edge file, never a filter.

partner.wedgeNote: When the Collective Edge block mark stands on a Royal surface, its wedge is Royal purple. Use the shipped file from the Collective Edge kit.

use: Open every document on the Dark Purple #2F193B band.
Use Purple #572E72 for accents and brand-colored text on white.
Keep white text on Dark Purple, Purple or Royal Purple only.
Use the horizontal lockup wherever it fits.
Add Powered by Collective Edge once, beside the Royal mark.
avoid: Do not set Light Purple #8260A2 as body text.
Do not use Light Purple as a large background.
Do not use a brand purple as a status color.
Do not recolor a logo or invert it with a CSS filter.
Do not separate the crown from the wordmark in the horizontal lockup.
Do not use a background tint stronger than #F0E1FD.
Do not sample a partner facility color from a logo.

character: Written for the reader who is between calls
voice: Write for the reader who is between calls.
Name partners and facilities exactly as they write themselves.
No em dashes. A period, a comma or a middot.

ps: From 1 December, case managers book next-day discharge rides before 10:00. Dispatch confirms each one within 15 minutes.
A confirmation names the unit and the pickup window. If no unit is free in the window, call the case manager before the 15 minutes run out.
The crew calls the nursing station 20 minutes before arrival. Dispatch does not make that call.
Requests after 10:00 are still taken. Confirm them in the order received, after the morning requests, and give the case manager the earliest open window.
acts: Staff one dispatcher on the ordering page from 07:00 to 10:00.
Reply to every request with a unit and a window.
Log any ride confirmed late, with the reason.

onePager.lead: From 1 December, book next-day discharge transport before 10:00. Royal confirms each ride within 15 minutes.
onePager.pa: The case manager sends the request through the ordering page. Dispatch assigns a unit and replies with a pickup window. The crew calls the nursing station 20 minutes before arrival.
onePager.close: If a discharge moves, call dispatch. The unit holds for 15 minutes past the window, then returns to service.

deck.title: Discharge transport
deck.h: Book by 10:00. Royal confirms in 15 minutes.
pts: Dispatch replies with a pickup window.
The crew calls 20 minutes before arrival.

agentLine: Royal Ambulance is an operating company under Collective Edge. Purple palette, the crown lockup, the house type system.
